MONOTREE_ISSUER.description: The customer's Monotree address, e.g. https://acme.monotree.com. No trailing slash.

OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: The client_id Monotree sent you when it registered this dashboard.

OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The client_secret Monotree sent you with the client_id.

MONOTREE_API_KEY.description: An Open API key (mono_...) from Monotree's CMS, with only the scopes src/data.ts needs. read:stats for the example.

SESSION_SECRET.description: A long random string. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32

ACCESS.description: Who may open the dashboard: anyone, admins, editors, managers, group:<id>, manager:<id>. Comma-separated.
